natural: take the essence and use it widely

meaning.en: To select the best from a wealth of material and use it broadly.
meaning.zh: 从大量材料中提取精华，广泛运用。

equivalents: draw the best from a broad range

examples.zh: 做学问要取精用宏，不能死读书。
examples.en: Scholarship means distilling the best from much material, not just poring over books.

examples.zh: 这本教材取精用宏，把各家之长融于一体。
examples.en: This textbook draws the best from many sources and combines them.

examples.zh: 设计师取精用宏，把传统纹样用到了现代产品上。
examples.en: The designer took the best of traditional patterns and applied it to modern products.

usage.en: Predicate; formal, used for study, research and creative work.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；较正式，用于学习、研究、创作。

meaning.en: Unusual local customs and ways of life that differ from one's own.
meaning.zh: 与众不同、新奇少见的风俗习惯。

examples.zh: 旅行中最有趣的，是各地的奇风异俗。
examples.en: The most interesting thing about travelling is the strange customs of each place.

examples.zh: 这本书记录了边疆地区的奇风异俗。
examples.en: This book records the unusual customs of the border regions.

examples.zh: 初到异国，他对当地的奇风异俗充满好奇。
examples.en: Newly arrived abroad, he was curious about the unfamiliar local customs.

usage.en: Noun phrase; used of travel and folk customs.
usage.zh: 名词性短语；用于旅行、民俗介绍。

pinyin: bēi zhī wú shèn gāo lùn
literal: lowly · it · not · very · lofty · discussion
natural: nothing high-flown, please keep it down-to-earth

meaning.en: To keep talk down to earth; or to say that an opinion is quite ordinary, nothing special.
meaning.zh: 把话说得浅近一些，不要高谈阔论；后也指议论平常，没有什么高明之处。

examples.zh: 他的发言卑之无甚高论，却句句实在。
examples.en: His speech was nothing lofty, yet every word was practical.

examples.zh: 文帝要求大臣们说话务实，卑之无甚高论。
examples.en: The emperor asked his ministers to speak plainly and practically.

examples.zh: 这篇文章卑之无甚高论，只是把常识讲了一遍。
examples.en: This essay is quite ordinary and merely runs through common sense.

story.en: When Zhang Shizhi began to speak of lofty matters before Emperor Wen of Han, the emperor told him to keep it plain: 'Make it down to earth, no lofty talk; it must be something that can be done now.'
story.zh: 汉文帝对张释之说：“卑之，毋甚高论，令今可施行也。”

usage.en: Self-deprecating or dismissive, according to the speaker; literary.
usage.zh: 可用于自谦，也可用于评价他人的议论平庸；书面语。

meaning.en: A harmonious attitude brings good fortune and peace.
meaning.zh: 待人和善，和睦相处，就会带来吉祥平安。

examples.zh: 和气致祥，邻里之间多一份宽容，少一份计较。
examples.en: Harmony brings good fortune; among neighbours, be more forgiving and less petty.

examples.zh: 店里的老板常说和气致祥，从不跟客人争吵。
examples.en: The shop owner always says harmony brings luck and never argues with customers.

examples.zh: 一家人和气致祥，日子自然越过越好。
examples.en: When a family lives in harmony, life naturally gets better and better.

story.en: Liu Xiang's memorial says that harmony brings good omens, while discord brings calamity: 'Harmonious air brings good fortune, discordant air brings disaster' (和气致祥，乖气致异).
story.zh: 刘向上疏言：“和气致祥，乖气致异；祥多者其国安，异众者其国危。”

usage.en: Predicate or quoted maxim; used in advice, couplets and mottos.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或格言引用；用于劝诫、对联、家训。

meaning.en: Riddled with errors; mistakes appear everywhere.
meaning.zh: 错误很多，到处都是。

examples.zh: 这篇报道谬误百出，引起了读者的批评。
examples.en: This report was riddled with errors and drew criticism from readers.

examples.zh: 他的论证谬误百出，根本站不住脚。
examples.en: His argument is full of mistakes and simply does not stand up.

examples.zh: 那本译文谬误百出，根本不能参考。
examples.en: That translation is full of errors and cannot be used for reference.

usage.en: Predicate; criticism of writing, argument, reports.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；用于批评文章、论证、报道。

natural: welcome the gods and hold the festival

meaning.en: A traditional folk festival with processions and offerings to welcome local gods.
meaning.zh: 旧时民间举行的祭神集会，抬着神像出游，并有各种游艺。

equivalents: a folk festival for the gods

examples.zh: 每年春天，镇上都要迎神赛会，十分热闹。
examples.en: Every spring the town holds a festival to welcome the gods, and it is very lively.

examples.zh: 迎神赛会是旧时乡村最盛大的节日。
examples.en: The temple procession was the greatest festival in the old countryside.

examples.zh: 作家描写了儿时看迎神赛会的情景。
examples.en: The author describes watching the god-welcoming festival as a child.

usage.en: Noun phrase; describes old folk customs, often in memoirs and ethnography.
usage.zh: 名词性短语；多用于描述旧时民俗，常见于回忆文章。

meaning.en: For a high-ranking person to lower himself and deal with people of lower status.
meaning.zh: 地位高的人降低身份，屈就地位低的人。

examples.zh: 总经理纡尊降贵，亲自到工地慰问工人。
examples.en: The general manager condescended to visit the workers at the site in person.

examples.zh: 他纡尊降贵，请一位普通教师做顾问。
examples.en: He lowered himself to ask an ordinary teacher to be his adviser.

examples.zh: 她不愿纡尊降贵去求那个人帮忙。
examples.en: She is unwilling to demean herself by asking that person for help.

usage.en: Predicate; can be respectful (humility) or ironic (condescension); the form 降尊纡贵 is equally standard.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；可褒可贬，既可表示谦和，也可带有讽刺；“降尊纡贵”同义。

meaning.en: Surviving remnants of a defeated bad force or old order.
meaning.zh: 指残存下来的坏势力或坏分子。

examples.zh: 警方彻底清除了这个犯罪团伙的残渣余孽。
examples.en: The police completely wiped out the remnants of the criminal gang.

examples.zh: 革命胜利后，仍需肃清旧社会的残渣余孽。
examples.en: After the revolution the remnants of the old society still had to be cleared out.

examples.zh: 他们是前朝的残渣余孽，一直在暗中活动。
examples.en: They are leftover elements of the old regime and have been active in secret.

usage.en: Noun; derogatory; common in political and crime writing.
usage.zh: 名词；贬义，常见于政治、犯罪类文字。

meaning.en: To select officials through civil-service examinations, as in imperial China.
meaning.zh: 古代设置科举考试，选拔人才做官。

examples.zh: 隋唐时开科取士，给寒门子弟带来了机会。
examples.en: The Sui and Tang dynasties selected officials by examination, bringing opportunity to poor families.

examples.zh: 朝廷开科取士，天下读书人纷纷赶往京城。
examples.en: The court held the examinations and scholars all over the land hurried to the capital.

examples.zh: 开科取士制度对后世的选才方式影响深远。
examples.en: The exam-selection system had a profound influence on later ways of choosing talent.

usage.en: Predicate; used in historical context.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；用于历史语境。

natural: pray to the gods and consult divination

meaning.en: To seek help from gods and fortune-telling, usually in times of uncertainty.
meaning.zh: 向神灵祈求，用占卜问吉凶。

examples.zh: 遇到难事，他不去想办法，只会求神问卜。
examples.en: Facing difficulty he does not look for a solution but only prays and consults fortune-tellers.

examples.zh: 旧社会的人遇到灾病，往往求神问卜。
examples.en: In the old society people often prayed to the gods and consulted diviners when disaster or illness came.

examples.zh: 做生意还是要靠本事，别总想着求神问卜。
examples.en: In business you must rely on ability and not always pray and divine.

usage.en: Predicate; often mildly disapproving, describing superstition.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；常略带贬义，指迷信行为。

meaning.en: A group of friends; a small circle of companions.
meaning.zh: 指几个朋友，泛指众多朋友。

examples.zh: 周末他常跟三朋四友一起聚餐。
examples.en: At weekends he often has meals with a bunch of friends.

examples.zh: 三朋四友来家里坐坐，屋里很热闹。
examples.en: A few friends came round and the house was lively.

examples.zh: 他喜欢结交三朋四友，到处都有熟人。
examples.en: He likes making friends and has acquaintances everywhere.

usage.en: Noun phrase; casual, sometimes a little mocking about idle companions.
usage.zh: 名词性短语；口语，有时带有调侃闲散朋友的意味。

natural: the rivers flow to the sea as vassals to a king

meaning.en: Rivers flowing to the sea; metaphor for all peoples turning to one centre.
meaning.zh: 长江、汉水奔流入海，比喻诸侯朝见天子，或众人归向。

equivalents: all streams flow to the sea

examples.zh: 江汉朝宗，是古人对大河入海的形象描写。
examples.en: 'Rivers paying court to the sea' was the ancients' vivid picture of great rivers entering the sea.

examples.zh: 各路英才江汉朝宗，纷纷投奔新政权。
examples.en: Talents from all quarters converged like rivers flowing to the sea and joined the new regime.

examples.zh: 长江汉水汇流东去，江汉朝宗，气象万千。
examples.en: The Yangtze and the Han join and run east, rivers paying court to the sea in great variety.

story.en: In the 'Yu Gong' chapter, the Yangtze and Han are said to 'pay court to the sea' (江汉朝宗于海), like vassals visiting the king.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; classical, used of rivers and of general allegiance.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；古语，既写江河入海，也比喻众望所归。

meaning.en: To love study and reflect deeply on what one learns.
meaning.zh: 爱好学习，并且深入思考。

equivalents: love study and reflect on it

examples.zh: 他好学深思，在同龄人中显得格外成熟。
examples.en: Studious and reflective, he seemed unusually mature among his peers.

examples.zh: 好学深思的学生，往往能学得更扎实。
examples.en: Students who love study and think deeply often learn more soundly.

examples.zh: 导师称赞她好学深思，是难得的人才。
examples.en: The supervisor praised her as studious and thoughtful, a rare talent.

story.en: Sima Qian ends the Annals of the Five Emperors by saying one must be a person who 'loves learning and thinks deeply, and understands the meaning in his heart' (好学深思，心知其意).
story.zh: 《史记·五帝本纪》太史公曰：“非好学深思，心知其意，固难为浅见寡闻道也。”

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; praise for students and scholars.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；用于称赞学生、学者。

meaning.en: Debauched and tyrannical; said of a ruler who indulges in pleasure and misrules.
meaning.zh: 生活放纵淫乱，行事暴虐，不讲道义，多指统治者。

examples.zh: 这位荒淫无道的君主最终被推翻了。
examples.en: This debauched and tyrannical ruler was finally overthrown.

examples.zh: 史书记载他荒淫无道，不理朝政。
examples.en: The histories record that he was dissolute and neglected state affairs.

examples.zh: 小说里的昏君荒淫无道，百姓怨声载道。
examples.en: The foolish king in the novel is debauched and unjust, and the people grumble everywhere.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; used for tyrants and corrupt rulers.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；用于暴君、昏君。

meaning.en: Writing or action that is natural, flowing and effortless, like wind rippling across water.
meaning.zh: 风吹过水面，自然成纹，比喻文章自然流畅，不事雕琢。

examples.zh: 他的文章风行水上，毫无雕琢之痕。
examples.en: His prose flows like wind over water, with no trace of artifice.

examples.zh: 这位书法家下笔风行水上，一气呵成。
examples.en: The calligrapher writes as naturally as wind across water, in one breath.

examples.zh: 好的演讲应该风行水上，自然而然地打动人。
examples.en: A good speech should flow like wind on water and move people naturally.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; praise for style, literary.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；用于赞美文风，书面语。

natural: a book of lecture notes with commentary at the top

meaning.en: Pedantic, high-flown exegesis or academic writing that is hard to read; originally annotated classics with commentary in the upper margin.
meaning.zh: 原指旧时刻在书页上方的经书讲解，后指内容空泛、枯燥难懂的讲章式文字。

examples.zh: 这篇论文满篇高头讲章，读来索然无味。
examples.en: The paper is full of pedantic exposition and is dull to read.

examples.zh: 他不喜欢高头讲章式的教学，更看重实例。
examples.en: He dislikes pedantic lecture-style teaching and values examples more.

examples.zh: 文件写得像高头讲章，基层干部看不懂。
examples.en: The document is written like a pedantic treatise that grassroots cadres cannot follow.

usage.en: Noun; critical, usually of academic or official writing.
usage.zh: 名词；批评口气，多指学术或公文写作。

natural: when the husband rises, the wife is honoured

meaning.en: When the husband gains rank and status, his wife shares the honour.
meaning.zh: 丈夫地位显贵，妻子也跟着享受荣耀。

equivalents: a wife honoured through her husband

examples.zh: 她盼着夫贵妻荣，日子能好起来。
examples.en: She hopes for her husband to rise so she shares his honour and life gets better.

examples.zh: 旧时讲夫贵妻荣，女性往往依附丈夫的地位。
examples.en: In the old days it was 'husband honoured, wife glorified', and women often depended on their husbands' status.

examples.zh: 他当上厂长后，真应了夫贵妻荣那句老话。
examples.en: After he became factory manager, the old saying about the wife sharing the husband's honour came true.

usage.en: Predicate or quoted saying; traditional, now often used with mild irony.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或引用俗语；带传统色彩，今多略含调侃。

meaning.en: A single stick of sincere respect or devotion offered in the heart.
meaning.zh: 一瓣香表示衷心的敬意；比喻内心真诚的敬仰。

examples.zh: 谨以一瓣心香，敬献给敬爱的老师。
examples.en: I offer a heartfelt tribute to my beloved teacher.

examples.zh: 这首小诗是我献给先烈的一瓣心香。
examples.en: This little poem is my sincere tribute to the martyrs.

examples.zh: 他写下一瓣心香，纪念逝去的朋友。
examples.en: He wrote a sincere tribute in memory of his departed friend.

usage.en: Noun phrase; used in dedications and eulogies; literary and respectful.
usage.zh: 名词性短语；用于题献、悼词；书面、敬重色彩。

meaning.en: What the powerful person says becomes law; absolute power.
meaning.zh: 说出的话就是法律，形容权势极大，言出法随。

examples.zh: 他自以为口含天宪，谁也不放在眼里。
examples.en: He thinks his word is law and respects no one.

examples.zh: 权臣口含天宪，满朝文武无人敢言。
examples.en: The powerful minister's word was law, and no official in court dared speak.

examples.zh: 在这家公司，老板口含天宪，没人敢反对。
examples.en: In this company the boss's word is law and no one dares object.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; criticises abuse of power.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；批评滥用权力。

meaning.en: To be able to face Heaven with a clear conscience; to have nothing to be ashamed of.
meaning.zh: 抬头不愧对上天，指问心无愧，行为光明正大。

examples.zh: 我一生仰不愧天，俯不怍人。
examples.en: All my life I have had no need to feel ashamed before Heaven or man.

examples.zh: 他做事仰不愧天，从不担心别人调查。
examples.en: He acts with a clear conscience and never worries about investigation.

examples.zh: 只要仰不愧天，何惧流言蜚语？
examples.en: So long as one is not ashamed before Heaven, why fear gossip?

story.en: Mencius lists as one of the gentleman's three joys: 'looking up, not ashamed before Heaven; looking down, not abashed before men' (仰不愧于天，俯不怍于人).
story.zh: 《孟子·尽心上》：“仰不愧于天，俯不怍于人，二乐也。”

usage.en: Usually paired with 俯不怍人; predicate or quote, formal.
usage.zh: 常与“俯不怍人”连用；多作谓语或引用，较正式。

natural: the head of Wu and the tail of Chu

meaning.en: A region on the old border of the states of Wu and Chu, roughly the middle Yangtze area of Jiangxi.
meaning.zh: 指古代吴国与楚国交界处，大致在今江西一带。

examples.zh: 九江地处吴头楚尾，文化兼有两地特色。
examples.en: Jiujiang lies at the Wu-Chu border and its culture mixes both.

examples.zh: 诗人提到的吴头楚尾，指的是江西一带。
examples.en: The 'Wu head, Chu tail' mentioned by the poet means the Jiangxi region.

examples.zh: 这座古城位于吴头楚尾，历来是兵家必争之地。
examples.en: This old city lies on the Wu-Chu borderland and was always a contested military site.

usage.en: Geographic and historical reference; literary.
usage.zh: 地理、历史用语；书面语。

natural: make the nation flourish and secure the state

meaning.en: To make the country prosperous and the state stable.
meaning.zh: 使国家兴盛，使邦家安定。

equivalents: make the nation prosper and stable

examples.zh: 教育是兴国安邦的根本大计。
examples.en: Education is the fundamental plan for making the nation flourish and secure.

examples.zh: 他立志兴国安邦，毕生为国家奉献。
examples.en: He resolved to make the country prosper and stable and gave his life to it.

examples.zh: 科技创新是兴国安邦的重要力量。
examples.en: Scientific innovation is an important force for national prosperity and stability.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; formal, in news and speeches.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；较正式，常见于新闻、讲话。

meaning.en: Writing or speech that is plain and easy to understand, like ordinary conversation.
meaning.zh: 文字浅显易懂，像日常说话一样。

examples.zh: 白居易的诗明白如话，老妪都能听懂。
examples.en: Bai Juyi's poems are as plain as speech, so even old women could understand.

examples.zh: 这篇科普文章明白如话，孩子也能读懂。
examples.en: This popular-science article is as clear as everyday speech and children can follow it.

examples.zh: 合同条款要写得明白如话，避免争议。
examples.en: Contract terms should be written in plain language to avoid disputes.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; praise for plain style.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语；赞扬文字通俗。
